authority.application: authentication, authorization, role/security, data, business rules, logical presentation destination
authority.canonical_sh3d: geometry, rooms, doors/openings, authored physical cameras, spatial routes, physical presentation

house_1.name: Public / Hero House
house_1.transfer_rule: House 1 remains the public arrival/home; legal/footer routes do not require physical house transfer.

house_2.name: Operations + Broker
house_2.transfer_rule: Enter through an authored House 2 opening; no teleport into a role room.

house_3.name: Seekers + Owners
house_3.transfer_rule: Enter through an authored House 3 opening; seeker/owner pages remain application-authorized.

navigation_rules: UI requests a logical presentation destination; UI never supplies or invents physical camera coordinates.
A route may cross rooms/houses only through an authored door/opening chain.
Camera motion must not pass through walls or closed geometry.
For each transfer, animate exit from the current hero/room, traverse the validated route, animate each required door open/close, cross the threshold, then settle at the destination hero camera.
Travel duration is route-authored and must be preserved; it is not replaced by a zero-duration camera jump.
Door animations are part of the route contract, not decorative UI-only effects.
A destination hero is a physical resting state; intermediate route cameras are not arbitrary UI targets.
If no validated physical route exists, the application must not fabricate one; the destination remains logically requested but physically unresolved until spatial authority is authored.

ui_dependencies.change_policy: Do not rename, merge, split, or relocate DOM targets during 3D work without reconciling CSS/JS/animation/responsive consumers.
